narrative: Two black-letter bills, side by side, titles only. He reads the Rose's first. Half a mouth, and a clove. He does not turn back as he starts up the street. No sum is written on either sheet. The Rose's title is the one still in his eye. A carter could pass in the time it takes to read it. No author on either bill.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read both titles, Rose first, and did not look back.
